video_title: Darius Acuff Jr. Talks 2026 NBA Draft Workouts, Jalen Brunson, Steph Curry, & Detroit Roots

quotes.speaker: Darius Acuff
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Acuff on Jalen Brunson's defensive navigation
quotes.excerpt: I've been seeing how Jalen Brunson is navigating through the defense and stuff like that.

text_blocks.speaker: Draymond Green
text_blocks.text: Have you been watching these games? Anything you're watching specifically?

text_blocks.speaker: Darius Acuff
text_blocks.text: Yeah, I've been watching. I've been focused on both teams, of course, but really been seeing how Jalen Brunson is navigating through the defense and stuff like that. As a point guard myself, I've been paying attention to that.

quotes.speaker: Darius Acuff
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Acuff picks Jalen Brunson for Finals MVP
quotes.excerpt: If the series end, I got to give it to Jalen Brunson.

text_blocks.speaker: Draymond Green
text_blocks.text: If you had to pick the Finals MVP right now, who is it?

text_blocks.speaker: Darius Acuff
text_blocks.text: If the series end, I got to give it to Jalen Brunson. He's doing something different.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green on Victor Wembanyama's defensive impact
quotes.excerpt: Wembanyama's guarding him, and he's pulling Wembanyama away from the rim. So now you got Wembanyama away from the rim.
quotes.quote: Wembanyama's guarding him, and he's pulling Wembanyama away from the rim. So now you got Wembanyama away from the rim. He's not rebounding as well. Wembanyama has the same amount of rebounds in this series as Josh Hart does. And so he's not rebounding as well because he's pulled away from the rim. He's also not having the same impact entirely on the game defensively because he's pulled away from the rim.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green on the league's perception of his intensity
quotes.excerpt: A lot of guys in the league has had a problem with me because a lot of guys have felt like I don't play hard enough.
quotes.quote: A lot of guys in the league has had a problem with me because a lot of guys have felt like I don't play hard enough, I don't play tough enough, I don't play with the intensity that most people want to see. And I think in watching these playoffs, he's changed that entirely, and it's the key to why they're having the success that they've had.

quotes.speaker: Darius Acuff
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Acuff on his father's influence on his game
quotes.excerpt: Ever since I was born, he's been that one person that I've worked out with, growing up.
quotes.quote: Ever since I was born, he's been that one person that I've worked out with, growing up. He kind of was my AAU coach too. So for the first couple years of my AAU time, my pops was my coach, so I had him on the sidelines with me.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green on Rashad Phillips' basketball mind
quotes.excerpt: He's one of the most brilliant basketball minds that I've seen.
quotes.quote: He's one of the most brilliant basketball minds that I've seen. From the things that he says, the way he breaks down the game, but then also the way he evaluate talent. I think he evaluates talent better than most people in the NBA.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green on Damian Lillard's scouting
quotes.excerpt: This dude would be like, 'Yo, Damian Lillard, this kid a freshman over at Weber State, watch out for him.'
quotes.quote: This dude would be like, 'Yo, Damian Lillard, this kid a freshman over at Weber State, watch out for him.' Four years later, Damian Lillard a top-six pick. Like the way he evaluate talent is insane.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green on his early development as a guard
quotes.excerpt: Shaq was my favorite player growing up, right? So, Speedy would tell me like, 'Hey man, I know you love Shaq.'
quotes.quote: Shaq was my favorite player growing up, right? So, Speedy would tell me like, 'Hey man, I know you love Shaq. Shaq's seven feet, Dray. You six-six. You Richard Hamilton. How you guard size, Dray? You got to start shooting the three, you got to bring the ball up.'

quotes.speaker: Darius Acuff
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Acuff on learning leadership from Speedy
quotes.excerpt: Speedy the first person to, you know, teach me how to really like be a leader, you know, of a team.
quotes.quote: Speedy the first person to, you know, teach me how to really like be a leader, you know, of a team. I was young, playing up, and he just told me like, 'The team going to go as you go. That's one thing you got to learn.'

quotes.speaker: Darius Acuff
quotes.excerpt: Make sure your teammates love you first, and then that's when you you start playing the game more.
quotes.quote: Make sure your teammates love you first, and then that's when you you start playing the game more.

quotes.speaker: Darius Acuff
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Acuff on the importance of asking questions
quotes.excerpt: Lately, I've been trying to ask more questions just to see how the game, you know, how the game goes.
quotes.quote: Lately, I've been trying to ask more questions just to see how the game, you know, how the game goes. We coming from college, we young, we freshman, you want to know how it goes.

quotes.speaker: Darius Acuff
quotes.excerpt: He was the first person, I think at the end of the year, towards my end of my freshman year, like start drawing fouls more.
quotes.quote: He was the first person, I think at the end of the year, towards my end of my freshman year, like start drawing fouls more. Like start, not necessarily like flopping, but like, like getting to the line more because the team started guarding me different.

quotes.speaker: Darius Acuff
quotes.summary_phrase: Darius Acuff on wanting to guard his matchup
quotes.excerpt: I'm definitely one of the guys, I I like to guard my matchup for sure, because I don't want nobody to get off, you know, more than me.
quotes.quote: I'm definitely one of the guys, I I like to guard my matchup for sure, because I don't want nobody to get off, you know, more than me. So, I want to guard my position for sure.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green on the importance of defensive effort
quotes.excerpt: Show that you want to defend, because when I see these guys come into the league and they don't want to guard their position, they're running from a matchup, the only thing people do is pick on you more.
quotes.quote: Show that you want to defend, because when I see these guys come into the league and they don't want to guard their position, they're running from a matchup, the only thing people do is pick on you more. If you come into the league as a guy and they figure out, 'Oh man, he don't want to guard,' it just puts you in a worse position because now every action that they run down the court is at you.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green on the value of defensive coaches
quotes.excerpt: Find the coach you're going to go to a team, they're going to have an offensive coordinator, they're going to have a defensive coordinator. Find that coach that's the defensive coordinator.
quotes.quote: Find the coach you're going to go to a team, they're going to have an offensive coordinator, they're going to have a defensive coordinator. Find that coach that's the defensive coordinator. Lock in with that coach, because I'm going to tell you this, half the battle of guarding in the NBA is knowing what a team want to do.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green on the importance of film study
quotes.excerpt: It's very important for you as a point guard to be a film junkie, to learn how to watch film.
quotes.quote: It's very important for you as a point guard to be a film junkie, to learn how to watch film. You got to make this shit your life if you want to be as great as you can possibly be.

quotes.speaker: Draymond Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green on the life cycle of an NBA athlete
quotes.excerpt: As you get older, it's like you go from not having any importance to you grow, you grow, you have this importance, and then you start to get older, and you really don't know, right?
quotes.quote: As you get older, it's like you go from not having any importance to you grow, you grow, you have this importance, and then you start to get older, and you really don't know, right? Like you really don't know how somebody looking at you anymore. You really don't know how the young guys feel about you and different things as you go through it because you get older, and respect it go from no respect to all the respect, and then you almost lose it again.
